resources.string: Enjoy the game? Support is optional

Tips will support continued development and maintenance of Liquid Wars, and help build a budget for future server costs.\n\nPublic online multiplayer is currently unavailable because funding is limited and server costs are high. It may become available when funding and technical conditions allow. Availability and timing will be announced if plans become concrete.

Choose an amount within your means. Playing does not require a tip. Tips grant no coins, items, ranking benefits, priority, or other game privileges.\n\nSupport is for users aged 18 or over with full legal capacity. Minors should not send tips.

This is a voluntary personal tip to the developer, not charitable fundraising. No charitable donation receipt or tax deduction certificate is provided.\n\nReview the recipient, amount, and platform rules in WeChat before deciding. The game does not charge you automatically or confirm payment. Contact the developer about mistaken payments, payments by minors, or other concerns for assistance under applicable law. Your statutory rights remain unaffected.
